Method of Attack: Takes over calls to a bank’s customer support number and connects the victim directly with cybercriminals
Disguises as a mobile banking app with official logos and customer support number
Breaks real call connection and shows fake call screen
Plays pre-recorded audio messages mimicking bank greetings
Spoofs incoming calls to contact victims posing as bank support
Requests permissions to access contact list, microphone, camera, geolocation, call handling
Spies on victim by broadcasting real-time audio and video, location, copying files and text messages
Drops and deletes incoming calls to block and hide real bank calls
Impacted Systems: Android devices, specifically users in South Korea
Attack Vector: Disguised mobile app installation requesting dangerous permissions
Indicators of Compromise: Fake call screen mimicking bank interface
Pre-recorded Korean audio messages from KakaoBank and Kookmin Bank
Permissions requested: contact list, microphone, camera, geolocation, call handling
